sloka: स तं समुत्पाट्य खमुत्पपात वित्रास्य लोकान् ससुरासुरेन्द्रान्।संस्तूयमानः खचरैरनेकैर्जगाम वैगाद् गरुडोग्रवेगः ।। ६.७४.६८ ।।
transliteration: sa taṁ samutpāṭya khamutpapāta vitrāsya lokān sasurāsurendrān।saṁstūyamānaḥ khacarairanekairjagāma vaigād garuḍogravegaḥ ।। 6.74.68 ।।

translations.english: Resembling the Sun closely, radiant like the Sun he was taking the top of the mountain, betaking himself in the vicinity of the Sun he was like another Sun.
